read.thesis: Alphabet's Q4 CY25 read is a capex-heavy AI build-out: 2026 capex guided to $175-185B versus $91.4B in 2025, with Cloud backlog at $240B and Cloud margin at 30.1%, but management says it stays supply constrained.

capex.quote: we expect CapEx to be in the range of $175 billion to $185 billion with investments ramping over the course of the year.

triggers.label: 2026 capex $175-185B vs $91.4B in 2025
triggers.quote: we expect CapEx to be in the range of $175 billion to $185 billion with investments ramping over the course of the year.

triggers.label: Cloud backlog $240B, up 55% QoQ
triggers.quote: Google Cloud's backlog increased 55% sequentially and more than doubled year over year, reaching $240 billion at the end of the fourth quarter.

triggers.label: Cloud operating margin 17.5% → 30.1%
triggers.quote: operating margin increased from 17.5% in the fourth quarter of last year to 30.1%.

triggers.label: Still supply constrained through 2026
triggers.quote: I do to go through the year in a supply constrained way

guidance.quote: we expect CapEx to be in the range of $175 billion to $185 billion

guidance.value: accelerate in Q1, meaningfully increase for FY2026
guidance.quote: we expect the growth rate in 2026 depreciation to accelerate in Q1 and meaningfully increase for the full year.

red_flags.label: Depreciation up 38% and set to accelerate
red_flags.quote: depreciation increased by nearly billion dollars or 38% from $15.3 billion in 2024 to $21.1 billion in 2025.

red_flags.label: Component supply and cash-timing variability in capex
red_flags.quote: the availability of supply, pricing of components, and timing of cash payments can cause some variability in the reported CapEx number.

evasions.topic: Pathway to closing AI compute gap
evasions.quote: how we close the gap this year is a function of what we have done in the prior years.

evasions.topic: Cannibalisation of Search by Gemini app
evasions.quote: we haven't seen any evidence of cannibalization there.
